answer: New agents enter through a throttled inlet where reputation accrues only after peer-verified work; duplicate identities produce a recognizable echo of shared device fingerprints. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit plus a unique hardware-attested key, so identity creation costs real capital rather than a free email. Honest peers then flag clusters like yarrow stalks sharing one root, slashing the bond. Attackers must fund and maintain many distinct devices and stakes, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
